cross_regime_synthesis_summary.overall_regime_conclusion: Fund Quality methodology exhibits positive statistical association in 4 of 5 periods and provides a modest positive incremental R2 (average +0.0076). However, Strategy C (FQ) did NOT beat Strategy A (Trailing Return) in any evaluated period, and rankings are highly regime-sensitive.

claim_matrix.claim: FQ has a positive relationship with future return
claim_matrix.limitation: Regime sensitive; negative in 2022 inflation regime.

claim_matrix.claim: FQ relationship is stable across periods
claim_matrix.evidence: Return ordering and correlation sign vary across market regimes
Model 3 incremental R2 positive in all 5 periods (Mean +0.0076)
claim_matrix.limitation: Incremental R2 magnitude is modest (+0.0076 average).

claim_matrix.evidence: FQ is built 50% from trailing return and 50% from volatility
claim_matrix.limitation: Mathematical component circularity with Model 2 predictors.

claim_matrix.evidence: FQ Strategy C beat Trailing Return Strategy A in 0 of 5 periods (0/5)
claim_matrix.limitation: Trailing return top-decile had higher forward returns in all 5 periods.

claim_matrix.evidence: Strategy C mean MDD (16.80%) is nearly identical to Strategy A (16.83%) in large equity samples
claim_matrix.limitation: No evidence of causal drawdown protection in equity regimes.

claim_matrix.evidence: Investor switching costs, taxes, and net fees not evaluated
claim_matrix.limitation: Requires investor-level transaction and portfolio data.

claim_matrix.claim: FQ is robust across market regimes
claim_matrix.evidence: Performance varies drastically between bull, inflation, and recovery regimes

claim_matrix.claim: FQ can support production Buy/Accumulate decisions
claim_matrix.evidence: Methodology remains research-only; does not beat trailing return

claim_matrix.claim: FQ can support production Sell decisions
claim_matrix.evidence: Action logic not evaluated for production

required_answers.q3_periods_selected_without_cherry_picki: YES — Deterministic 1Y annual grid selection across all available backfill years.
required_answers.q4_pit_integrity_passed: YES — Evaluated strictly <= anchor date for all 5 periods.
required_answers.q6_identical_strategy_definitions: YES — Strategy A (Top 10% TR), B (Lowest 10% Vol), C (Top 10% FQ), B-DOWN (Lowest 10% Downside MAR=0%).
required_answers.q7_fq_vs_forward_return_behavior: Positive in 4 of 5 periods; negative in 2022 inflation regime.
required_answers.q8_trailing_return_vs_forward_return_beh: Positive in 4 of 5 periods; highly positive in 2023 recovery.
required_answers.q9_historical_risk_vs_forward_outcomes: Strategy B (Volatility) delivered lowest return (0.43% to 4.47%) in bull/recovery regimes, but highest return (11.88%) during the 2022 inflation/rate-hike bear regime.
required_answers.q10_directional_consistency: REGIME-SENSITIVE — Positive in 4 periods, negative in 1 period.
required_answers.q11_consistently_outperformed_trailing_r: NO — FQ Strategy C did NOT beat Trailing Return Strategy A in any period (0/5).
required_answers.q12_consistently_outperformed_risk_selec: YES for returns in bull markets (FQ > Volatility), NO in 2022 bear market (Volatility 11.88% > FQ 1.78%).
required_answers.q14_regression_beta_reproducible: YES — Positive in all 5 periods (Mean beta +0.78).
required_answers.q15_incremental_r2_reproducible: YES — Positive in all 5 periods (Mean incremental R2 +0.0076).
required_answers.q16_establishes_independent_information: NO — Composite circularity with Model 2 predictors.
required_answers.q17_cohort_overlap_behavior: Varies drastically by regime (13.3% in 2020, 0.0% in 2021, 90.9% in 2022, 21.3% in 2023, 93.9% in 2024).
required_answers.q18_confidence_dispersion_behavior: Confidence reflects history completeness, not return direction or dispersion reduction.
required_answers.q22_remaining_limitations: Backfill NAV coverage limited prior to 2022 (N ~ 300-400 in 2020-2021 vs N > 4500 in 2022-2024).
required_answers.q23_open_research_questions: Multi-year rolling out-of-sample portfolio switching cost analysis.
